differential.name: Chronic kidney disease, stage 3 (likely secondary to hypertension)
differential.rationale: Elevated creatinine (1.5 mg/dL) with normal BUN suggests reduced GFR; anemia and dyslipidemia are common CKD sequelae.

differential.name: Heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia
differential.rationale: LDL 223 mg/dL and total cholesterol 276 mg/dL with low HDL are classic for genetic hypercholesterolemia, especially at age 46.

differential.name: Essential hypertension
differential.rationale: Common in Black adults; likely contributor to CKD and dyslipidemia, though BP not recorded, the comorbidity pattern fits.

differential.name: Metabolic syndrome (obesity, prediabetes, dyslipidemia)
differential.rationale: BMI 30+, A1c 6.2 %, high LDL/low HDL constitute metabolic syndrome driving cardiovascular risk.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease (secondary to CKD)
differential.rationale: Presence of anemia with CKD and chronic inflammation (e.g., sinusitis) points to anemia of chronic disease.
